summary: Backend-only testing of RootRecord Token Manager API. All 20 pytest cases passed (100%). Covered: /api/health, POST /api/wallets/connect (valid, idempotent, 7 invalid inputs), GET/PATCH preferences (defaults, updates, invalid-network, empty body), contacts CRUD with owner isolation + 404 on unknown id + invalid-address rejection + empty-label rejection, /api/price/sol (default vs=usd, 45s cache identical updated_at), /api/network/endpoints (all 3 networks + default). Verified no MongoDB _id leaks in any response payload.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') hook — works today but will be removed; consider migrating to lifespan context manager.

SOL price cache is per-process in-memory (_PRICE_CACHE dict). With multiple uvicorn workers each worker will have its own cache, so CoinGecko call frequency scales with worker count. Not a blocker at this stage.
_validate_pubkey accepts any 32-byte base58 decode, but does not verify the key is on the ed25519 curve. That's consistent with non-custodial UX requirements and acceptable.
PATCH preferences does not validate currency against a whitelist (only network is whitelisted). Product decision — flag only, not a bug.

Contact note is defaulted to '' which is fine; create_contact returns the raw dict (not the ContactOut model) so new fields added to DB later could leak into responses — consider returning via a response_model.
test_credentials: N/A — non-custodial, no auth. Pubkey is identity.
seed_data_creation: Test-created wallets for pubkeys HXk3aFzLwVWqBz2eVrRq3fKoFMq6WjkP8mC9N2abF1Ax and 5Q544fKrFoe6tsEbD7S8EmxGTJYAKtTVhAW5Q5pge4j1 remain in db.wallets; all TEST_* contacts were deleted by the test teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/token-manager-app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py. Run: `cd /app/token-manager-app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (falls back to the preview URL). Valid 32-byte base58 pubkeys used: HXk3aFzLwVWqBz2eVrRq3fKoFMq6WjkP8mC9N2abF1Ax, 5Q544fKrFoe6tsEbD7S8EmxGTJYAKtTVhAW5Q5pge4j1, and the System Program '11111111111111111111111111111111' for contact addresses. CoinGecko is live (not mocked) — if that service is down or rate-limited, price tests will surface as 502s.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Implementation matches the spec exactly: pubkey validation chain (regex -> base58 decode -> 32-byte length check) all produce 400; idempotent wallet connect preserves created_at; contact isolation enforced by owner=pk query; SOL price TTL cache correctly returns identical updated_at within 45s window; all responses strip MongoDB _id via projection or _strip().
